name: @skopos/workspace
description: Self-hosting workspace root for the Skopos SDK subtree

scripts.web:verify: pnpm web:typecheck && pnpm web:test && pnpm web:build
scripts._cli:build: pnpm --filter @unisane/skopos exec -- tsup && node packages/cli/scripts/copy-policy-packs.mjs && node packages/cli/scripts/copy-skill-packs.mjs && node packages/cli/scripts/copy-ui-app.mjs
scripts._cli:test: pnpm --filter @unisane/skopos exec -- vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=15000 src/__tests__/package-boundaries.test.ts src/__tests__/release-surface.test.ts src/__tests__/canonical-surface.test.ts src/__tests__/compact-command-output.test.ts src/__tests__/help-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/instructions-sync-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/action-guard-authority.test.ts src/__tests__/action-evidence.test.ts src/__tests__/browser-evidence.test.ts src/__tests__/verification-recommendation-evidence.test.ts src/__tests__/task-change-scope.test.ts src/__tests__/task-portability.test.ts src/__tests__/task-ownership-expansion.test.ts src/__tests__/progressive-workflow.test.ts src/__tests__/host-projection-model.test.ts src/__tests__/host-actor-binding.test.ts src/__tests__/session-context-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/setup-workflow.test.ts src/__tests__/setup-readiness-reconstruction.test.ts src/__tests__/coordination-broker.test.ts src/__tests__/coordination-lifecycle.test.ts src/__tests__/adoption-assessment.test.ts src/__tests__/adoption-proposal.test.ts src/__tests__/adoption-approval.test.ts src/__tests__/adoption-verification.test.ts src/__tests__/project-artifact.test.ts src/__tests__/source-dependency-digest.test.ts src/__tests__/document-catalog.test.ts src/__tests__/scope-registry.test.ts src/__tests__/policy-recommendation-portability.test.ts src/__tests__/storage-lifecycle.test.ts src/__tests__/product-interface-design-showcase.test.ts src/__tests__/design-context-library.test.ts src/__tests__/skill-context-resolution.test.ts src/__tests__/skill-evaluations.test.ts
scripts.release:check: pnpm --filter @unisane/skopos exec -- vitest run src/__tests__/package-boundaries.test.ts src/__tests__/release-surface.test.ts
scripts.proof: pnpm --filter @unisane/skopos exec -- vitest run --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=15000 src/__tests__/task-portability.test.ts src/__tests__/coordination-broker.test.ts src/__tests__/setup-workflow.test.ts src/__tests__/setup-readiness-reconstruction.test.ts
scripts.instructions:sync: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts instructions sync . --json
scripts.skopos:setup: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts setup . --json
scripts.skopos:scan: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts scan . --json
scripts.skopos:session: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts session context . --json
scripts.skopos:ui: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts ui render . --json
scripts.skopos:ui:app: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts ui build .
scripts.skopos:ui:dev: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts ui dev .
scripts.skopos:ui:serve: pnpm exec node --import tsx packages/cli/src/cli.ts ui serve .
